shouldOverwrite.description:
If set to true, any previous {@link AssetClass}es that were created from definition files will be deleted
before creating new ones.

trackingId.description:
An identifier that will be used to identify {@link ReliabilityAssetClassDefinitionParserJobBatchResult}s that will
be created in the job. This is necessary since {@link } is a singleton.

title: Options that can be provided when starting a {@link ReliabilityAssetClassDefinitionParserJob}.
name: ReliabilityAssetClassDefinitionParserJobOptions
